requirements.title: The runner MUST perform compiler/generator preparation exactly once per qualification attempt and reuse the prepared outputs for Q1 and Q2. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: The runner MUST perform compiler/generator preparation exactly once per qualification attempt and reuse the prepared outputs for Q1 and Q2. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: The runner MUST emit separate fail-closed Q1 and Q2 outcomes tied to one deterministic preparation digest. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-001, AC-003)
requirements.text: The runner MUST emit separate fail-closed Q1 and Q2 outcomes tied to one deterministic preparation digest. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-001, AC-003)

requirements.title: The optimized suite MUST preserve all eight positive invariant checks with equivalent pinned Quint/Apalache semantics. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-002)
requirements.text: The optimized suite MUST preserve all eight positive invariant checks with equivalent pinned Quint/Apalache semantics. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-002)

requirements.title: The optimized suite MUST preserve all 51 negative controls and MUST reject every mutation for its expected reason. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-002)
requirements.text: The optimized suite MUST preserve all 51 negative controls and MUST reject every mutation for its expected reason. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-002)

requirements.title: Any preparation, Q1, Q2, telemetry, or evidence failure MUST fail the qualification attempt without converting an unknown or missing result into success. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-003)
requirements.text: Any preparation, Q1, Q2, telemetry, or evidence failure MUST fail the qualification attempt without converting an unknown or missing result into success. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-003)

requirements.title: Hosted canonical Quint MUST run in a job that has no dependency on the compiler-and-architecture-test job, while retained qualification evidence MUST depend on both. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-004)
requirements.text: Hosted canonical Quint MUST run in a job that has no dependency on the compiler-and-architecture-test job, while retained qualification evidence MUST depend on both. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-004)

requirements.title: The runner MUST emit a schema-versioned machine-readable receipt containing Q1/Q2 outcomes, phase durations, relevant external-process counts, pinned tool identities, canonical input digests, preparation digest, and result digest. (Stories: US-002, US-003; Acceptance: AC-003, AC-005)
requirements.text: The runner MUST emit a schema-versioned machine-readable receipt containing Q1/Q2 outcomes, phase durations, relevant external-process counts, pinned tool identities, canonical input digests, preparation digest, and result digest. (Stories: US-002, US-003; Acceptance: AC-003, AC-005)

requirements.title: Positive multi-invariant verification, bounded mutation parallelism, or Quint server reuse MAY be adopted only after result-equivalence checks and hosted measurements; concurrency MUST be explicitly capped. (Stories: US-004; Acceptance: AC-006)
requirements.text: Positive multi-invariant verification, bounded mutation parallelism, or Quint server reuse MAY be adopted only after result-equivalence checks and hosted measurements; concurrency MUST be explicitly capped. (Stories: US-004; Acceptance: AC-006)

requirements.title: The reusable formal runner MUST NOT invoke SDD lifecycle commands for a hard-coded work item; lifecycle evidence remains the responsibility of the active roadmap item. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-007)
requirements.text: The reusable formal runner MUST NOT invoke SDD lifecycle commands for a hard-coded work item; lifecycle evidence remains the responsibility of the active roadmap item. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-007)

requirements.title: Documentation and executable contract tests MUST describe and enforce the new job topology, receipt schema, exact pins, timeouts, result cardinalities, and retained evidence relationships. (Stories: US-002, US-003; Acceptance: AC-002, AC-004, AC-005)
requirements.text: Documentation and executable contract tests MUST describe and enforce the new job topology, receipt schema, exact pins, timeouts, result cardinalities, and retained evidence relationships. (Stories: US-002, US-003; Acceptance: AC-002, AC-004, AC-005)

requirements.title: Before/after hosted evidence MUST report at least five samples when feasible, including median and p95 wall time, phase durations, and process counts, with any smaller sample explicitly identified as provisional. (Stories: US-003, US-004; Acceptance: AC-006)
requirements.text: Before/after hosted evidence MUST report at least five samples when feasible, including median and p95 wall time, phase durations, and process counts, with any smaller sample explicitly identified as provisional. (Stories: US-003, US-004; Acceptance: AC-006)

decisions.title: CQ-001: decision: Combine the eight positive invariants in one Quint --invariants invocation only after local result equivalence; retain separate invocations if pinned-tool behavior differs.
decisions.decision: CQ-001: decision: Combine the eight positive invariants in one Quint --invariants invocation only after local result equivalence; retain separate invocations if pinned-tool behavior differs.

decisions.title: CQ-002: decision: Benchmark mutation concurrency 1, 2, and 4; begin with an explicit cap of 2 and retain the smallest stable winner under hosted memory and reliability constraints.
decisions.decision: CQ-002: decision: Benchmark mutation concurrency 1, 2, and 4; begin with an explicit cap of 2 and retain the smallest stable winner under hosted memory and reliability constraints.

decisions.title: CQ-003: decision: Adopt Quint server reuse only if five hosted samples show at least 10 percent median improvement with identical outcomes and stable resources; otherwise record its rejection.
decisions.decision: CQ-003: decision: Adopt Quint server reuse only if five hosted samples show at least 10 percent median improvement with identical outcomes and stable resources; otherwise record its rejection.

decisions.title: CQ-004: decision: Emit Q1 immediately after the one shared deterministic preparation succeeds; emit Q2 after positive verification and all 51 negative controls finish.
decisions.decision: CQ-004: decision: Emit Q1 immediately after the one shared deterministic preparation succeeds; emit Q2 after positive verification and all 51 negative controls finish.

decisions.title: CQ-005: decision: Emit one schema-versioned JSON receipt with phase timings, process counts, pinned tool identities, input/preparation/result digests, and Q1/Q2 outcomes.
decisions.decision: CQ-005: decision: Emit one schema-versioned JSON receipt with phase timings, process counts, pinned tool identities, input/preparation/result digests, and Q1/Q2 outcomes.

decisions.title: CQ-006: decision: Remove hard-coded SDD commands from the reusable Quint runner; enforce SDD through the active roadmap item lifecycle and retained item evidence.
decisions.decision: CQ-006: decision: Remove hard-coded SDD commands from the reusable Quint runner; enforce SDD through the active roadmap item lifecycle and retained item evidence.
